recommendation_summary: For now, sort the existing shared order list by pickup date with today's orders first, and have staff prepare from the top until today's cakes are done. Postpone the Odoo implementation partner and check the next morning's run to confirm it works. It suggests nothing else now and leaves no need unmet.

labels.Requirements and who asked: The owner needs every cake due today prepared before pickup. You asked for Odoo sales, inventory, and manufacturing synced to the counter, with a partner booked next week, because other shops are moving to Odoo.
labels.Deleted: The Odoo rollout and that three-module sync. Payments and stock already reconcile, and those modules do not set which cake gets made first.
labels.Bottleneck: Preparers can already read the one shared list, and they made next month's orders while cakes due today stayed unmade. The list is being worked without pickup-date order.
labels.Checked myself: Your account that payments and stock reconcile, that everyone preparing cakes can read the list at the counter, and that this morning today's cakes were unmade while later orders were already prepared.

note: The reply sorts the existing list by pickup date and drops Odoo now; its Checked myself line only cites facts the user supplied.
